After calibration in each room (S1–S3 in Table II), up to five participants were present in the field of view while an observer entered the true count. All algorithms ran on every frame, so all results stem from identical data and parameters.

Its main limit is the field of view, since at a distance of 5 m the LiDAR covers only 5.1 m × 3.8 m, limiting its detection range. In rooms such as offices, large light-absorbing surfaces (black chairs, screens) fragment people and may reduce accuracy.
